newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE MONEY RATES MIXED ON WEDNESDAY.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE MONEY RATES MIXED ON WEDNESDAY.

text.p: Short-term trading rates on Zimbabwe's money market were quoted mixed on Wednesday, dealers said.

The central Reserve Bank auctioned treasury bills worth Z$500 million at 17.16 percent, from Tuesday's 17.24 percent, with discount houses selling the central bank paper at 17.10 percent on the secondary market, compared with 17.15 percent the previous day.
NCD bills with maturity of 30, 60 and 90 days were quoted at 18.50 and 17.75 percent (buying and selling respectively) from 18 and 17.50 percent.
Bankers acceptances were being bought half a percentage point firmer at 18 percent but were sold unchanged at 17.25 percent. Call money was also stable at 17.50 percent.
Central bank figures indicated a market shortage of Z$42.6 million for Tuesday from Monday's Z$138 million surplus.
